idea-plugin.name: Rider Tests Support Plus
idea-plugin.description:
Adds to the Unit Tests window what the built-in one lacks. Everything else in the window works as before.

  • Save and load test sessions (.rtsession), including parametrized tests such as TestClass(A).TestName(X). Tests are resolved by name after loading, so a session survives a changed project GUID or target framework. Missing tests trigger a rescan, then fall back to their parent, and anything unresolved is reported.
  • Import a session from .runsettings: RunConfiguration/TestCaseFilter is evaluated by dotnet vstest, NUnit/Where by the NUnit engine, so the session holds exactly the tests dotnet vstest would run.

The actions are in the session's Export/Import menu. Supported test framework: NUnit 3/4.

action.description: Save the tests of this session, including parametrized ones, to a .rtsession file
Open a session saved to a .rtsession file, resolving its tests by name
Create a session from the tests selected by the TestCaseFilter of a .runsettings file
